assumptions: source assumption: inherent availability scope - ideal support environment, includes corrective maintenance downtime, excludes logistics/waiting/administrative and preventive downtime (page Definitions section).
MTBF and MTTR in consistent time units; steady-state (limiting) availability.
Component is repairable; one-off/non-repairable elements use the MTTF form instead.

gaps: Meanings mtbf/mttr/inherent_availability and time units absent from runtime vocabulary; scalar form fits engine once meanings exist.
MTBF vs MTTF accounting (repairable vs one-off) must be selected at bind time; see limitations.

models.inverse_notes: MTBF = A*MTTR/(1-A) needs A != 1; MTTR = MTBF*(1-A)/A needs A != 0. Check: A=0.99998,MTTR=2 gives MTBF = 0.99998*2/0.00002 = 99998 (rounding of 100000). A=1 forces MTTR=0 with MTBF free; A=0 forces MTBF=0 against guard (degenerate never-up). Algebraic only.
limitations: Inherent (design-control) scope only; achieved/operational availability with logistics and preventive downtime need separate records.
MTBF > 0 required: a never-operating (MTBF=0) degenerate has no steady-state availability.
MTBF/MTTR are estimated inputs with often-high uncertainty (source basic example warns MTTF-class parameters are uncertain); never measured claims about real hardware.

references.method: EventHelix component table: input transducer MTBF 100000 h, MTTR 2 h gives 99.998%. 100000/100002 = 0.99998 exactly to shown digits.

assumptions: Both endpoint definitions describe the same mathematical object: a steady-state probability that the item is operable under stated conditions (inherent record output definition; complement record input A definition).
The mission instant at which the component availability is read samples the steady state: no burn-in, wear-out trend, or time-varying failure intensity across the evaluation.
Ideal-support scope carries over: the value counts corrective-maintenance downtime only and excludes logistics/waiting/administrative and preventive downtime.
Element/item identity: the element whose inherent availability was computed is the item whose mission-instant availability is read; no fleet averaging or cross-item substitution.

gaps: No runtime projection in this research return; admission projects the identity with the two registry-exact ports.

models.inverse_notes: Unique inverse Ai = A for A in [0,1]: substitution check A=0.99998 restores Ai=0.99998. Values outside [0,1] map back against the guards (rejected in both directions). No branches or singularities; the inverse inherits the same scope assumptions. Algebraic only.
limitations: Not for achieved or operational availability: values computed with logistics, administrative, or preventive downtime must not enter this adapter.
Not for instantaneous or interval availability outside the steady state, and not a license to compose component values across a system (composition additionally needs independence and topology).
The adapter asserts scope compatibility only; it does not re-verify the upstream MTBF/MTTR estimates, whose uncertainty the inherent record flags as often high.
